# College of Arts & Media at CU Denver

> > CU Denver's College of Arts & Media (CAM) offers undergraduate and graduate programs in visual arts, music, film, television, and entertainment industry studies.

The College of Arts & Media serves as the creative hub at the University of Colorado Denver, featuring programs like Music & Entertainment Industry Studies (MEIS), film and television production, photography, digital design, and art history. The college showcases student and faculty work through galleries like the Emmanuel Art Gallery and CU Denver Experience Gallery, while supporting creative scholarship through grants, awards, and professional development resources.

## Five Questions Interview Series

- [Five Questions for the CAM Community](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/five-questions): Interview series featuring CAM students, faculty, and alumni
- [Five Questions Details](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/five-questions/five-questions-details): Detailed interviews with Shepard Fairey and CAM community members
- [Get to Know Autumn Cierra](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-autumn-cierra): Photography BFA student Autumn Cierra shares her CAM journey
- [Get to Know Elizabeth Pugliano](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-elizabeth-pugliano): Art history Professor Elizabeth Pugliano on medieval art and teaching
- [Get to Know Mariely Marquez-Lopez](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-mariely-marquez-lopez): Digital Design student and scholarship recipient Mariely Marquez-Lopez
- [Get to Know Sebastien Chiu](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-sebastien-chiu): Film & Television alum Sebastien Chiu on audio industry consulting
- [Get to Know Shawntisha Bailey](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-shawntisha-bailey): MEIS student Shawntisha Bailey on music business and entertainment law
- [Get to Know Diccon Conant](https://artsandmedia.ucdenver.edu/about-cam/newsroom-details/5-questions/get-to-know-diccon-conant): Senior Academic Advisor Diccon Conant on supporting CAM students
